pins.title: Trace Photos Onto Real Paper
pins.description: Set your phone above paper, choose a photo, fade the guide and trace with your own pencil. Lock the picture to help keep it steady.

pins.title: Turn a Photo Into Line Art

pins.title: Lettering Templates to Trace

pins.title: A Simple Sea Life Drawing

reddit.question: What’s a straightforward iPhone app for tracing my own photo onto paper?
reddit.reply: Linework lets you trace your own photos with its tracing tools. Stand your phone above the paper, position the guide and lock it before drawing. After the 14-day trial, tracing your own photos stays free.

reddit.question: Can I make line art from a photo on my iPhone without uploading it?
reddit.reply: Linework’s photo-to-sketch feature processes images on your phone, with four styles plus detail and line-thickness controls. The full library and photo-to-outline are included in Linework Plus, a one-time A$2.99 purchase.

reddit.question: Any drawing app with lettering templates I can trace onto paper?
reddit.reply: Linework has letter templates in 16 styles, including script, calligraphy and stencil. You can browse the library and trace a chosen design onto paper.
